_comment: What a program is, in plain words, shown after its maker line as "<name>: <what>". Never matched by name or path: an entry applies only to a program whose signature codesign --verify accepted, and only when BOTH its signing Identifier (the bundle id sealed in the signature and pinned in the verify requirement) AND its verified Team ID equal identifier and team_id here. team_id "apple" means Apple's own program: a part of macOS (anchor apple) or an Apple App Store app with a com.apple. identifier; these have no Team ID to pin. Third-party Mac App Store apps are left out, because their certificate is Apple's and the Team ID cannot be pinned. "match": "prefix" also covers helpers whose Identifier continues the identifier after a dot (com.google.Keystone -> com.google.Keystone.Agent), still only for the same team; anything else is an exact match. Unsigned, unverified, Homebrew and label-only programs never get a description. Every entry was confirmed with `codesign -dv --verbose=2` against a program installed on a real Mac. Style: one or two short everyday sentences saying what it is for (and, for background parts, what they do and whether they are normal to see); say plainly what remote-access or recording tools let someone do; never claim something is safe.

programs.name: Google Chrome
programs.what: Google's web browser, for visiting websites.

programs.name: Google's updater
programs.what: keeps Chrome and other Google apps up to date in the background. It is normal to see on a Mac with Chrome.

programs.name: Google Software Update
programs.what: Google's older updater; keeps Chrome and other Google apps up to date in the background. It is normal to see on a Mac that has had Chrome.

programs.name: Google Antigravity
programs.what: Google's AI coding app, used to write software with the help of AI.

programs.name: Brave
programs.what: a web browser that blocks ads and trackers.

programs.name: Comet
programs.what: Perplexity's web browser, with an AI assistant built in that can read and act on the pages you open.

programs.name: Zoom
programs.what: an app for video calls and online meetings. A small part of it runs in the background to check for updates.

programs.name: Zoom's helper
programs.what: a background helper Zoom installs to update itself and do tasks that need administrator rights. It is normal to see if Zoom is installed.

programs.name: Gather
programs.what: a virtual office app where people meet, talk and share screens in a shared online space.

programs.name: Signal
programs.what: a private messaging app for texts and calls, linked to the Signal app on your phone.

programs.name: Element
programs.what: a messaging app for chatting on the Matrix network.

programs.name: Jami
programs.what: a messaging and calling app that connects people directly, without a central server.

programs.name: Dropbox
programs.what: keeps the files in your Dropbox folder in sync with your Dropbox account online and your other devices.

programs.name: Dropbox's updater
programs.what: keeps the Dropbox app up to date in the background. It is normal to see if Dropbox is installed.

programs.name: Amazon Photos
programs.what: backs up photos and videos from this computer to your Amazon account.

programs.name: Adobe Core Sync
programs.what: part of Adobe Creative Cloud; keeps your Creative Cloud files and fonts in sync with this computer in the background.

programs.name: Adobe Creative Cloud Experience

programs.name: Adobe's installer helper

programs.name: Claude
programs.what: Anthropic's AI assistant app, for chatting with Claude.

programs.name: Claude Code link helper
programs.what: a small helper that opens Claude Code, Anthropic's AI coding tool, when you click a Claude Code link.

programs.name: Cursor
programs.what: a code editor with AI built in, used to write software.

programs.name: Ollama
programs.what: runs AI chat models on this computer instead of on the internet.

programs.name: LM Studio
programs.what: downloads AI chat models and runs them on this computer.

programs.name: ComfyUI
programs.what: makes pictures and videos with AI models that run on this computer.

programs.name: OpenClaw
programs.what: a personal AI assistant that can act on this computer for you, such as running commands, reading files and sending messages through chat apps. A part of it keeps running in the background.

programs.name: Amical
programs.what: a dictation app: it listens through the microphone while you talk and types what you say.

programs.name: Wispr Flow
programs.what: a dictation app: it listens through the microphone while you talk and types what you say into any app.

programs.name: Loom
programs.what: records your screen and camera to make video messages you can share with a link.

programs.name: OBS Studio
programs.what: records or live-streams your screen, camera and sound.

programs.name: Streamlabs Desktop
programs.what: a live-streaming app that broadcasts your screen, camera and sound to sites like Twitch and YouTube.

programs.name: EMEET Studio
programs.what: the settings app for EMEET webcams, microphones and speakerphones.

programs.name: Opal Composer
programs.what: the app for Opal webcams: camera settings, effects and a camera other apps can use.

programs.name: Opal's camera helper

programs.name: Rogue Amoeba's audio capture helper

programs.name: Rogue Amoeba's audio capture tool
programs.what: installs and looks after Rogue Amoeba's audio capture helper, which lets their audio apps capture and record sound from other apps.

programs.name: CapCut

programs.name: Filmora
programs.what: a video editing app.

programs.name: Frame.io Transfer
programs.what: uploads and downloads large video files to and from Frame.io, a service for sharing video projects.

programs.name: VLC
programs.what: a media player for videos and music.

programs.name: Ableton Live
programs.what: software for making, recording and performing music.

programs.name: Audacity
programs.what: an app for recording and editing sound.

programs.name: Splice
programs.what: downloads sounds and samples for making music.

programs.name: ACE Studio
programs.what: music software that makes singing voices with AI.

programs.name: Visual Studio Code
programs.what: Microsoft's code editor, used to write software.

programs.name: Minecraft Launcher
programs.what: downloads, updates and starts the game Minecraft.

programs.name: Steam
programs.what: Valve's store and launcher for video games. Some of its parts run in the background to look after Steam and your games.

programs.name: Godot
programs.what: a tool for making video games.

programs.name: Inky
programs.what: an editor for writing interactive stories in the ink language.

programs.name: Tiled
programs.what: an editor for drawing maps and levels for video games.

programs.name: Blender

programs.name: MeshLab
programs.what: an app for viewing and fixing 3D models.

programs.name: Bambu Studio
programs.what: prepares 3D models for printing and sends them to Bambu Lab 3D printers.

programs.name: Arduino IDE
programs.what: writes programs and loads them onto Arduino electronics boards.

programs.name: CP210x driver installer
programs.what: installs a driver for USB serial adapters (CP210x chips) used by many electronics boards.

programs.name: qFlipper
programs.what: the companion app for the Flipper Zero gadget: updates it and copies files to and from it.

programs.name: Raspberry Pi Imager
programs.what: writes an operating system onto an SD card or USB drive for a Raspberry Pi.

programs.name: balenaEtcher
programs.what: writes disk images onto USB drives and SD cards.

programs.name: Wireshark
programs.what: a tool that captures and shows the network traffic going in and out of this computer.

programs.name: Docker Desktop
programs.what: a tool for software developers that runs programs in sealed-off containers.

programs.name: Docker's network helper
programs.what: a background helper Docker Desktop installs to set up networking for its containers. It is normal to see if Docker Desktop is installed.

programs.name: OrbStack
programs.what: a tool for software developers that runs Linux and Docker containers on this Mac.

programs.name: OrbStack's helper
programs.what: a background helper OrbStack installs for tasks that need administrator rights, such as setting up networking. It is normal to see if OrbStack is installed.

programs.name: UTM
programs.what: runs other operating systems, such as Windows or Linux, in a window on this Mac.

programs.name: VirtualBox
programs.what: Oracle's app for running other operating systems, such as Windows or Linux, in a window on this computer.

programs.name: CrossOver
programs.what: runs Windows programs and games on a Mac without installing Windows.

programs.name: PostgreSQL
programs.what: a database server, usually installed for software development. It runs in the background so other programs can store data in it.

programs.name: Postgres.app
programs.what: runs a PostgreSQL database server on this Mac, usually for software development.

programs.name: pgAdmin
programs.what: an app for managing PostgreSQL databases.

programs.name: Beekeeper Studio
programs.what: an app for viewing and editing databases.

programs.name: TablePlus
programs.what: an app for viewing and editing databases.

programs.name: Mullvad VPN

programs.name: µTorrent Web
programs.what: downloads files with BitTorrent. While it runs, it also shares the files it has downloaded with other people.

programs.name: Caffeine
programs.what: keeps this Mac from going to sleep while it is switched on.

programs.name: Notion
programs.what: an app for notes, documents and shared to-do lists, stored in your Notion account online.

programs.name: Obsidian
programs.what: a note-taking app that keeps your notes as files on this computer.

programs.name: Taskade
programs.what: an app for to-do lists, notes and team projects, with AI built in.

programs.name: Zotero
programs.what: keeps track of research papers and helps make citations.

programs.name: calibre
programs.what: organises e-books and copies them to e-readers.

programs.name: Kiwix
programs.what: lets you read Wikipedia and other websites without an internet connection.

programs.name: Gephi

programs.name: Electric Sheep
programs.what: a screen saver that shows animated art shared by computers around the world.

programs.name: Pages
programs.what: Apple's word processor, for letters and documents.

programs.name: Numbers
programs.what: Apple's spreadsheet app.

programs.name: Keynote
programs.what: Apple's app for making slide presentations.

programs.name: GarageBand
programs.what: Apple's app for making and recording music.

programs.name: iMovie
programs.what: Apple's video editing app.

programs.name: Safari
programs.what: Apple's web browser, part of macOS.

programs.name: Finder
programs.what: the part of macOS that shows your files, folders and desktop.

programs.name: Terminal
programs.what: the part of macOS for typing commands to the computer instead of clicking.

programs.name: Script Editor
programs.what: the part of macOS for writing and running small automation scripts.

programs.name: Activity Monitor
programs.what: the part of macOS that shows which programs are running and how much of the computer they use.

programs.name: System Settings
programs.what: the part of macOS where you change this Mac's settings.

programs.name: Screen Sharing
programs.what: the part of macOS that lets you see and control another computer from this one.

programs.name: Apple Remote Management
programs.what: the part of macOS that lets someone see and control this Mac from elsewhere when Remote Management is turned on in Sharing settings.

programs.name: Screen Sharing service
programs.what: the part of macOS that lets someone see and control this Mac from elsewhere when Screen Sharing or Remote Management is turned on in Sharing settings.

programs.name: zsh
programs.what: the macOS command shell: it runs typed commands and scripts. Background tasks often use it to run a script, so what matters is the script it was given.

programs.name: bash
programs.what: an older macOS command shell: it runs typed commands and scripts. Background tasks often use it to run a script, so what matters is the script it was given.

programs.name: sh
programs.what: the basic macOS command shell: it runs typed commands and scripts. Background tasks often use it to run a script, so what matters is the script it was given.

programs.name: osascript
programs.what: the part of macOS that runs AppleScript automation scripts. What matters is the script it was given.

programs.name: open
programs.what: a small macOS command that opens a file or app, like double-clicking it.

programs.name: Apple's developer tools launcher

programs.name: ssh

programs.name: Remote Login service

programs.name: curl
programs.what: a macOS command that downloads or sends data over the internet.

programs.name: caffeinate
programs.what: a macOS command that keeps the Mac awake while something is running.

programs.name: cron
programs.what: the part of macOS that runs scheduled commands at set times.

programs.name: crontab
programs.what: the macOS command for viewing or changing scheduled commands.

programs.name: launchctl
programs.what: the macOS command for starting, stopping and listing background tasks.
